title: Reinforcing or Balancing?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Classify six causal loops from school change as reinforcing or balancing by counting the minus signs around each loop.

learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish six causal loops from school change as reinforcing or balancing by counting the minus signs around each, correctly classifying at least five of six on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Feedback loops, reinforcing and balancing loops, causal loop diagrams, and the counting rule, from the section "Seeing the System" in Chapter 18.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: A loop has two minus signs. Which type is it?
Can a loop with a minus sign be reinforcing?
commonMisconceptions: Reinforcing means good and balancing means bad
A loop with a minus sign cannot be reinforcing
The number of variables decides the type
assessmentOpportunities: A loop has two minus signs. Which type is it?
Can a loop with a minus sign be reinforcing?
Does the number of variables decide the type?
Is a reinforcing loop always good?

controls.name: Reinforcing and Balancing
